-- What a client importing `Proof.go_etcd_io.raft.v3.raftpb.CCEnumName` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def raftpb.ccTypeString (t : w32) : GoString :=
  match raftpb.ccTypeNames !! t with
  | some s => s
  | none => fmtInt (W64 (sint.Z t)) (W64 10)

def raftpb.ccTransitionString (t : w32) : GoString :=
  match raftpb.ccTransitionNames !! t with
  | some s => s
  | none => fmtInt (W64 (sint.Z t)) (W64 10)
